1.w: For the one directing. On stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, [and] cause His face to shine upon us, Selah

2.w: for the knowing of Your way on the earth, Your salvation among all nations.

3.w: May the peoples praise You, O God; may the peoples praise You—all of them.

4.w: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with uprightness, and You will guide the nations on the earth. Selah

5.w: let the peoples praise You, O God; let the peoples praise You—all of them.

6.w: The earth has given her produce; God, our God, blesses us!

7.w: God blesses us, and all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
